text:
maria: Heads-up — we're planning a schema change to capture metrics lineage. goal: remap analytics.namespace (currently uses route_id string) -> route_uid (stable UUID) + add origin_tag. This touches console dashboards, quota aggregation, and billing rollups. Need migration strategy for reads, writes, and dashboards.

kevin: Do we have to backfill history? can we do a read-adapter that maps route_uid->route_id for old queries?

anita: Read adapter helps, but query plans will diverge. backfilling 2 years of metrics will bloat indexes and slow p99s.

jess: Console dashboards assume route_id label. any mismatch will break saved queries and alerts. need a compatibility layer in the UI too.

sam: proposal: dual-write ingest (old columns + new columns) for 2 weeks on a canary cohort, start a targeted backfill for the last 30 days, then expand.

leo: main risk: quota windows are computed against the routing key. switching keys mid-window will change aggregates used for throttles/billing. must preserve invariants.

maria: rough phased plan I like: 
1) add nullable columns route_uid, origin_tag; do NOT change reads.
2) start dual-write from ingest layer and append new telemetry field.
3) run translation service that looks up route_uid for legacy route_id for backfill + queries.
4) backfill recent windows and validate parity.
5) cutover reads per-tenant via feature flag.

kevin: feature-flag per-tenant rollout via rollout-service sounds good. can we short-circuit for enterprise tenants that need SLAs?

anita: add perf checks: if console query p99 increases > 20% or >2s, auto-rollback the read-cut flag. Also create a dashboard to compare counts by key pre/post.

jess: need a migration notice in the console and update saved queries docs + migration guide for customers using custom dashboards.

sam: backfill note: SQL used for small window backfill: `UPDATE analytics.metrics SET route_uid = route_map_lookup(route_id) WHERE route_uid IS NULL;` we'll run in chunked txns by time bucket.

leo: also ensure billing ledger uses canonical route_uid mapping before any invoice calc. add a gating check in billing pipeline.

deploy-bot: migration job enqueued: metrics-lineage-backfill-01 scheduled 2025-04-15T03:00:00Z (ETA 36h run window)

maria: I'll own runbook + canary checklist. sam will own backfill pipeline, anita will own perf monitors and alerting, kevin will own feature-flag rollout, jess will own docs + UI compatibility.

sam: quick estimate: at 200k rows/sec sustained, backfilling 50B rows ~ 3 days, but we need headroom and replay overhead. probably safer to assume 5 days.

leo: add an invariant test: hourly quota sum(old_key) == hourly quota sum(new_key) +/- tiny epsilon before cutting reads. also test lease/lock semantics for concurrent writes.

maria: agreed. I'll add invariant checks to the PR and a list of abort conditions. Calendar: sync tomorrow 11:00am PT. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4321

kevin: :thumbsup:

jess: I'll start a migration-notice draft and attach it to the runbook.

anita: Also, log-level change during backfill: increase telemetry sampling for route_map misses so we can debug mappings.

maria: thanks all — will post the runbook and schedule the canary next week.
